usedFor: PixieBrix customises websites in the browser, and “Create Database” sets up a place to keep data.

bestTemplate.name: “New Meeting” in Google Meet, then “Create Database” in PixieBrix
bestTemplate.why: A new meeting can set up its own database, so notes and data have one place.

watchOut: “Create Database Trigger” is polling, so it is checked on a schedule and not at the instant of change.
